title: Skin Care for Jaipur Weather: A Routine for Dry Heat, Dust and Cold Winters
ex: Dry air most of the year, dusty summer heat, hard water and cold winter mornings: a simple skin care routine for people living in Jaipur.
rt: Skin Care for Jaipur Weather: Dry-Climate Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Jaipur weather: daily sunscreen, moisture for dry air, hard water tips, summer dust, cold winter mornings and rooftop days, kept simple.
quick: Jaipur is semi-arid, so skin is short on moisture for most of the year. A gentle face wash, moisturiser on damp skin, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a pea-sized night cream suit most people, with a little extra cream on cold winter nights.
facts: Jaipur has a semi-arid climate with a short monsoon
Summers (April to June) are very hot, dry and dusty
Groundwater in much of Rajasthan is hard
Winter mornings can be cold and very dry
